verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's GitHub README says official SDKs cover 15+ languages (TypeScript, .NET, Java and more) with framework integrations such as React and Next.js. The docs refer to both server-side and client-side SDKs, including server-side SDKs connecting to the Edge Proxy and a flag setting that blocks client-side SDK access. Missing for 10: dedicated SDK reference documentation in the pack, a per-language list or maturity detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
